title: OmniNetAgentToolManifest
description: Model-agnostic tool definitions for autonomous network optimization, repair, deep telemetry, and 10-minute self-scheduled maintenance across Windows, Linux, macOS, and BSD.

tools.name: network_diagnose
tools.description: Performs a complete, non-destructive diagnostic sweep of network health: evaluates gateway reachability, public internet connectivity, DNS resolution, latency, RFC 3550 jitter, packet loss, PMTU, and bufferbloat grade.

include_dns_benchmarks.description: Whether to include latency benchmarks for major public DNS resolvers.

tools.name: network_benchmark_dns
tools.description: Benchmarks major public Anycast DNS resolvers (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, OpenDNS) and returns ranked latency and reliability statistics.

domains.description: List of domain names to resolve during benchmark testing.

tools.name: network_generate_optimization_plan
tools.description: Formulates an OS-tailored optimization plan (TCP stack parameters, congestion provider like BBR/Cubic, RSS, RSC, MTU, DNS selection) based on recent diagnostics.

tools.name: network_execute_optimization
tools.description: Applies an optimization plan to the host operating system. MANDATORY SAFETY: Captures a rollback snapshot prior to applying any setting. Verifies post-change health; automatically reverts if degradation is detected.

plan_id.description: The plan ID returned by network_generate_optimization_plan.

execute.description: Set to true to apply changes to the operating system. If false, executes a simulated dry-run without system impact.

tools.name: network_triage_repair
tools.description: Executes hierarchical failure triage (L1 physical to L7 transport) and applies targeted remediation actions (DHCP lease renew, DNS cache flush, socket release, route table reset).

execute.description: Set to true to apply repair operations. If false, simulates and returns proposed repair steps.

tools.name: network_rollback
tools.description: Restores host network adapter and stack configuration to a previously recorded snapshot.

snapshot_id.description: The unique snapshot ID to restore.

execute.description: Set to true to execute restoration on host system. If false, simulates rollback.

tools.name: network_persistent_monitor
tools.description: Configures or samples the persistent background daemon for SLA drift monitoring and autonomous healing.

auto_heal.description: Whether the background sentinel should autonomously apply healing repairs when SLA is breached.

tools.name: network_discover_and_schedule_tasks
tools.description: Proactively scans all network layers, discovers needed optimization/repair tasks, schedules and executes them under Zero NetLoss safety, and sets the 10-minute (600s) recurring autonomous schedule.

execute.description: Whether to execute discovered tasks on the host OS immediately (default true).

tools.name: network_inspect_sockets
tools.description: Audits active TCP/UDP sockets, connection state counts (ESTABLISHED, TIME_WAIT, CLOSE_WAIT, SYN_SENT), top remote endpoints, and socket leak anomalies.

tools.name: network_discover_pmtu
tools.description: Performs binary-search DF-bit Path MTU discovery to determine exact maximum unfragmented packet size and optimal MTU.

target.description: Target IP or host to probe PMTU against.

tools.name: network_audit_arp_lan
tools.description: Scans the local ARP neighbor cache and detects duplicate MAC addresses (ARP spoofing/conflict) or local L2 anomalies.

tools.name: network_inspect_wifi_nic
tools.description: Audits Layer-1 Wi-Fi radio quality (SSID, Signal %, Band 2.4/5GHz, Channel, RX/TX Mbps) and active physical NIC adapters.

tools.name: network_traceroute
tools.description: Runs a fast hop-by-hop traceroute and bufferbloat delta test to pinpoint exact ISP or tunnel bottlenecks.

tools.name: network_speedtest
tools.description: Measures real HTTP/TLS Download Mbps, Upload Mbps, RTT and Jitter against Cloudflare Anycast Edge.

tools.name: device_full_maintenance
tools.description: Runs multi-OS full device maintenance and fault remediation (Storage/Temp cleanup, RAM/Process health, OS Integrity & Services, Network Stack & Ephemeral Ports, Power/NIC tuning, Hosts/Security audit) across Windows, Linux, macOS, and BSD.

execute.description: Set to true to execute maintenance routines with safety snapshot, false for dry-run.
